text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Mesin Cetak dan Penerbitan

(Larangan Penerbitan Tidak Diingini) 2023.

Larangan

2. Pencetakan, pengimportan, penghasilan, penghasilan semula, penerbitan,

penjualan, pengeluaran, pengelilingan, pengedaran atau pemilikan apa-apa penerbitan

sebagaimana yang diperihalkan dalam Jadual yang mungkin memudaratkan kemoralan

adalah dilarang secara mutlak di seluruh Malaysia.

JADUAL

(1)

Perihalan Penerbitan

(2)

Penerbit

Apa-apa penerbitan yang berkaitan dengan

Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer

and + Plus (LGBTQ+) dalam apa-apa bentuk

yang terdapat pada jam Swatch dalam

apa-apa koleksi termasuk kotak, pembalut,

aksesori atau apa-apa benda lain yang

berkaitan

Swatch Limited, Switzerland

Dibuat 9 Ogos 2023

[KDN.PK.S.600-16/15/122; PN(PU2)417/JLD.25]

 DATUK SERI SAIFUDDIN NASUTION BIN ISMAIL

 Menteri Dalam Negeri

PRINTING PRESSES AND PUBLICATIONS ACT 1984

PRINTING PRESSES AND PUBLICATIONS

(PROHIBITION OF UNDESIRABLE PUBLICATIONS) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 7 of the Printing Presses

and Publications Act 1984 [Act 301], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Printing Presses and Publications

(Prohibition of Undesirable Publications) Order 2023.

Prohibition

2. The printing, importation, production, reproduction, publishing, sale, issue,

circulation, distribution or possession of any publication as described in the Schedule

which is likely to be prejudicial to morality is absolutely prohibited throughout Malaysia.

SCHEDULE

(1)

Description of Publication

(2)

Publisher

Any publication related to Lesbian, Gay,

Bisexual, Transgender, Queer and + Plus

(LGBTQ+) in any form appearing on Swatch

watches of any collection including the

boxes, wrappers, accessories or any other

related things

Swatch Limited, Switzerland

Made 9 August 2023

[KDN.PK.S.600-16/15/122; PN(PU2)417/JLD.25]

 DATUK SERI SAIFUDDIN NASUTION BIN ISMAIL

 Minister of Home Affairs
